what: Past cloudbursts in Rome with measured or officially reported rainfall and the places reported flooded, for checking the rain flood + sewer model
note: Rain is given per municipio as reported; places are official street names (Roma Capitale toponomastica) or metro stations. A place 'near' another is the stretch of the first street closest to the second.

events.rain_source: Roma Capitale Protezione Civile via la Repubblica Roma, 3 Sep 2024: about 60 mm in under an hour in Municipio I; Municipi I, V, VI, XV over 40 mm
events.reports_source: Corriere della Sera Roma, la Repubblica Roma, Il Fatto Quotidiano, Sky TG24 (3 Sep 2024); 120 Polizia Locale interventions for flooding

events.rain_source: Dipartimento Protezione Civile Centro Funzionale via Roma Capitale: 30.8 mm/h at Roma EUR (30 mm in 15 minutes) and 30 mm/h at Casilino, between 03:00 and 04:00

MeteoWeb 14 Jun 2023 from Rome station networks: 86 mm Vigne Nuove and 55 mm Bufalotta (Municipio III, mean 70 used), 52 mm Salone and 51 mm Colle Prenestino (VI), 43 mm Prenestina Cocconi (V), 39 mm Macao (I). Afternoon storm; 2 hours is an assumption
events.reports_source: RomaToday (LuceVerde closures), Il Messaggero, Corriere della Sera Roma, MeteoWeb (Polizia di Roma Capitale), 14-15 Jun 2023

events.rain_source: Il Messaggero 10 Sep 2024: over 70 mm at Tor Vergata (VI), over 50 mm at EUR (IX), San Giovanni (VII), Monte Mario (XIV) and Bufalotta (III); over 20 mm in the first 10 minutes, then rain for hours (2 hours is an assumption)
events.reports_source: Il Messaggero, 10 Sep 2024 (metro stations closed for water damage; Municipio III offices flooded)

dry_check.note: an ordinary 10 mm/h shower: no flooding is normally reported
